claims: Venezuela defeated the United States 3-2 in the 2026 World Baseball Classic championship game on March 17, 2026.
The victory marked Venezuela's first-ever WBC title.
Eugenio Suárez drove in the go-ahead run in the ninth inning.
Daniel Palencia secured the final outs to clinch the victory over Team USA in Miami.
Eugenio Suárez hit a double in the top of the ninth inning to secure the lead.
Venezuela's Maikel Garcia was named the Tournament MVP.
Maikel Garcia hit a sacrifice fly earlier in the game to take an early lead.
The game was played at loanDepot park in Miami, Florida.
Prior to this, USA held a 3-2 head-to-head advantage over Venezuela in previous WBC matchups
